info.title: Ahab API
info.description: A self-hostable control plane for human-led, agent-assisted software work.

get.summary:
Every agent's defaults: the model, effort and permission mode a new
chat starts with, the last ones picked.

Every agent Ahab can run: its own, and the ACP registry's (the copy
shipped with Ahab until a fresh one is fetched, daily).
One session.

delete.summary: Removes a stopped chat from its session, with its history.

patch.summary: Renames a chat, or moves it to another session of its project.

get.summary:
One of the chat's subagents' conversation so far, as the events that
show it; what it does next comes on the chat's stream (`agentActivity`).

409.description: The agent cannot show its subagents' conversations

post.summary: Ends a live session; its history is kept.

200.description: Commands available in this live session

get.summary: A session's kept events, oldest first, up to 500 at a time.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Events after this number; 0 for all.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Read a page of earlier events before this sequence, or 0 for the latest page.

parameters.name: bounded
parameters.description: Cap the recent page even when the turn continues into earlier pages.

post.summary: Forks a completed turn into a separate provider conversation.
Stops the turn the agent is working on.
Sends a message to the session's agent.

202.description: Accepted for delivery, including a matching retry

put.summary:
Changes what the agent may do without asking. A running Claude Code
switches at once, Codex from its next turn; an ended chat resumes in it.

get.summary: A chat's model and effort, and the ones it goes on with next.

put.summary:
Chooses another model (or effort) of the chat's own agent: a stopped
chat resumes with it; a live one goes on with it from its next message,
its agent's own session resumed with it. The agent never changes.

get.summary: The live session's provider-defined modes.

put.summary: Puts the messages waiting for the agent's turn in a new order.

delete.summary: Takes back a message waiting for the agent's turn to end.

patch.summary: Changes the text of a message waiting for the agent's turn to end.

post.summary: Sends a waiting message next: the agent's running turn is stopped for it.

Answers a request: a permission, a question, a plan or a form. An
answer that does not fit the request is `invalid_decision`, and the
request stays open.
Stop one background task or subagent in a live session.

get.summary:
A page of one of the chat's background tasks' output. Read on from
`nextCursor` to follow a log still being written.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Where the last page ended (its `nextCursor`); absent for the start.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many bytes, 4 to 65536.

200.description: A page of the task's output

409.description: The agent cannot show a task's output

get.summary: A chat's turns, all of them, whatever part of its history is loaded.

What an agent's turn changed: its new problems and those it fixed, in
the files it changed and their dependents.
What a chat's agent has spent so far: tokens and cost, as it reported them.

The clients paired with this server, oldest first. Revoked clients are
not listed.
The client making this request.

post.summary:
Creates a token for a script: a client of kind `token`. The token is
shown only in this answer.

delete.summary:
Revokes a client: its next request gets `401 not_paired`, and its open
streams and connections close now. Revoking "This computer" writes it a
new credential at once.

post.summary:
A machine asks to join. It proves it holds its key; with a one-time code
it is approved at once, otherwise it waits (15 minutes at most) for
approval. The same key asking again gets its request back.

201.description: Pending, or active with a code

get.summary:
Where a request to join stands; the joining machine asks until it is
approved.
Ahab's core features, and which are on.

put.summary: Switches a core feature on or off, for everyone.

get.summary: Whether the server answers, and its version.
The codes that still work, newest first, without the codes themselves.

post.summary:
A new one-time code: a machine joining with it is approved at once. The
code is shown only in this answer; it works once, for 15 minutes.

get.summary: Every machine: the local one first, then by name.
One machine.

delete.summary:
Removes a machine; its key stops working and it must join again. The
server's own machine cannot be removed.

patch.summary: Renames a machine. Names are unique.

get.summary:
The agents on a machine, as last detected; empty until its daemon has
answered once.

post.summary:
Adds an agent to a machine: from the ACP registry (`agent`, such as
`acp:gemini`; npx and uvx agents) or custom (`name` and `program`).
Detection runs again in the background.
Detects the agents on a machine again, now.

get.summary:
Whether newer versions of a machine's agents are out (from npm), and
whether Ahab can install them there. Checked at most hourly.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Check now instead of answering from the last hour.

get.summary:
The plan limits of the agents signed in on a machine (Claude Code's and
Codex's): how much of each limit is used, and when it starts over. Asked
of the machine at most every 5 minutes; an offline machine answers with
what it last said.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Ask the machine now instead of answering from the last 5 minutes.

delete.summary: Removes an agent added to a machine; built-in agents cannot be removed.

get.summary: The models an agent offers on a machine, with their reasoning efforts.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Ask the agent now instead of answering with the models Ahab keeps.

post.summary:
Updates an agent on a machine with the agent's own updater (`claude
update`, `codex update`, `pi update --self`), then detects the agents
again. Takes up to a few minutes; agents installed by Nix are refused.

Approves a pending machine, so it may connect. Compare its check code and
fingerprint with the joining machine's screen first.

get.summary: The language servers a machine runs: their root, state and memory.

A language server's log: what it printed, and its LSP traffic when the
machine keeps it.

post.summary: Restarts a language server, with the files open in it.

get.summary:
A machine's CPU, memory, disks and busiest processes now, with every
process Ahab started. Process arguments are never sent.

A machine's tool settings: paths, extra environment, tools turned off
or added there, how many servers run at once.

Every tool record with its state on a machine (installed by Ahab,
found, available, cannot run), and the machine's runtimes.

parameters.name: rescan
parameters.description: Look for runtimes and tools again ("Scan again").

post.summary:
Installs a tool on a machine, into Ahab's data folder there, at the
version the registry pins. Its progress follows as `tools.job` events.
Stops a tool's servers and deletes what Ahab installed of it.

Installs the registry's newer version beside the old one, then restarts
the tool's servers and removes the old version.

get.summary:
The subfolders of a folder on a machine, for picking a project. Only
folder names, never files.

parameters.name: hidden
parameters.description: Include folders whose name starts with a dot.

get.summary: Where the folder picker starts on a machine: its user's home folder.
How many agents are working now.
The server's notification settings, with every kind.

put.summary: Changes the notification settings, all at once.

get.summary: The inbox: newest first, and how many are unread.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Those older than this notification (the next page).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many (1 to 200; 50 by default).

delete.summary: Clears the inbox of read notifications.

post.summary: Marks every unread notification read, of a project when given.
Marks a notification read.

Pairs this client with a pairing link's secret or a pairing code. A
browser gets its credential as a cookie; anything else gets it in the
answer. Ten tries a minute per address.

get.summary:
The requests waiting for an answer, oldest first. The event stream also
announces them (`pairing.requested`, `pairing.answered`).

post.summary:
A new client asks to be paired. Show the code; wait for the answer with
the secret. Every paired browser sees the request; it expires after 10
minutes.

get.summary:
The new client waits for the answer (a long poll). Once approved, the
answer pairs it: browsers get their cookie, others the credential, once.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: The secret the request was made with.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description:
How long to wait for an answer, in seconds: at most 30, 25 by
default, 0 to answer at once.

post.summary:
Approves a request: the waiting client is paired. `id` is the request's
ID or the code it shows.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The request's ID, or its code such as 7F3K

post.summary:
Denies a request: the waiting client is told so. `id` is the request's
ID or the code it shows.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The request's ID, or its code such as 7F3K

post.summary:
Creates a pairing link and code for a new client (Add client, `ahab
clients add`, `ahab open`). They work once, for 10 minutes; the secret
and code are shown only in this answer.

403.description: `not_local`: only this computer may ask for the first-run link

409.description: `already_paired`: a client is paired, so there is no first-run link

get.summary: A pairing link this server offered, to see whether it was used.

delete.summary: Withdraws a pairing link before it is used.

get.summary: How every plugin's daemon entry is doing on the machines online now.
The installed plugins, in the order their interceptors run.

post.summary:
Installs a plugin from a folder on the server's host or a Git URL. It
starts disabled.

422.description: `validation_failed`: no manifest, a manifest that breaks a rule, entries not built

get.summary: One plugin.

delete.summary: Removes a disabled plugin and its files.

patch.summary:
Changes where a plugin runs (when it asks to be placed) or its place
among interceptors.

post.summary:
Runs a plugin's command on a machine: the one given, the project's
(which also gives the command its folder), or the only one the plugin
runs on. Closing the request cancels the command. A machine's token
(its plugins calling) runs commands only on its own machine; without a
machine or project, that is where they run.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The command's name in the plugin, such as `containers.list`

403.description: `other_machine_not_allowed`: a machine's token, for another machine or its project

409.description: `plugin_disabled`, `plugin_not_running`, `command_failed` (with the plugin's message, and `pluginCode` when the plugin gave a code)

422.description: `validation_failed`: input the command refuses, or which machine is unclear

post.summary: Turns a plugin off everywhere.
Turns a plugin on.

409.description: `plugin_dependency_missing`: a plugin its `dependsOn` names is not installed, enabled or in range

get.summary:
A plugin's logs on a machine: its output and what it logged, the last
1,000 lines, kept in the daemon's memory.

post.summary: Sends a notification from a plugin, of a kind its manifest declares.

403.description: `plugin_not_here`: the plugin does not run on the calling machine

422.description: `validation_failed`: a kind it did not declare, or a field out of range

get.summary: A plugin's settings at a scope, and their schema.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The machine's or project's ID; none for the server.

put.summary: Sets a plugin's values at a scope; its entries hear of it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The machine's or project's ID; none for the server.

get.summary: The values in effect on a machine, or for a project.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project: its machine's values and its own apply.

post.summary:
Installs a plugin again from its folder or Git repository, keeping
whether it is enabled.

put.summary: Orders the projects by hand, as the project switcher lists them.

get.summary: Projects in the order chosen by hand, then by name: active ones, or archived ones.

post.summary:
Creates a project for a folder on a machine. The machine must be online,
to confirm the folder.

Opens a folder: its project if it is one, else a new project named after
the folder. What `ahab open` and the first-run picker use.

Keeps a file on the project's machine, outside the project's folder, to send
with a chat message. The body is the file's bytes (at most 10 MiB).

get.summary: A kept attachment's bytes.

Where Check project would run: each check command's roots, with the
repository or worktree each is in. With more than `askAbove` roots, the
web app asks which to check.

post.summary:
Runs a project's check commands now (those that run on request, or
those named) and stores what they found.

200.description: What ran, and the problems after

get.summary:
A file's content in a project, with its version; files up to 2 MiB
(larger ones in part, when asked).

parameters.name: partial
parameters.description:
For a file over 2 MiB, send its first part (`truncated`) instead of
answering `file_too_large`.

put.summary:
Saves a file: atomically, and only over the version the edit
started from (`expectedVersion`); a file changed meanwhile (by an agent,
Git or another client) is refused with `file_changed`. Without
`expectedVersion` it saves over whatever is there.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Relative to the project, with `/`; empty for its root.

delete.summary: Deletes a file, or a folder with everything in it.

parameters.name: expectedVersion
parameters.description: Delete a file only at this version.

get.summary: A folder's entries in a project: folders first, then files.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Relative to the project, with `/`; empty for its root.

post.summary:
Makes a new file or folder, with its missing parent folders;
never over something that exists (`already_exists`).

get.summary: The project's files, for quick open: paths following its ignore rules.

post.summary:
Moves or copies a file or folder inside the project (dragging it in
the file tree); over what is there only with `replace`, never into
itself.

422.description: `validation_failed`: into itself, or where it already is

post.summary:
Moves (renames) a file or folder inside the project; never
over something that exists (`already_exists`).
Aborts the unfinished merge, rebase, cherry-pick or revert.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

get.summary: Local and remote branches, most recent first.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

post.summary: Creates a branch, from the current one or `from`, and switches to it.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

post.summary: Deletes a local branch; one not merged only with `force`.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

post.summary: Renames a local branch.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

post.summary: Commits what is staged, or amends the last commit.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

get.summary: A commit: its message and files.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

post.summary: Continues the unfinished merge, rebase, cherry-pick or revert.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

get.summary: A file's two sides, for a group or a commit, to show side by side.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description: A repository inside the project's folder; absent for the one it is in.

schema.description: Which two sides a diff compares.

post.summary: Discards files' changes in the working tree; untracked files are deleted. Only inside the project's folder.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

post.summary: Fetches every remote.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

post.summary: Makes the project's folder a Git repository.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

get.summary:
Commits, newest first, paged: the current branch's, or with `all`
every branch's, remote branch's and tag's (the graph), parents after
their children.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description: A repository inside the project's folder; absent for the one it is in.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Every branch, remote branch and tag, not only the current branch's history.

post.summary: Pulls the current branch, as the machine's Git is configured to.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

post.summary: Pushes the current branch, setting its upstream when it has none.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

get.summary:
Where the project's Git is: the repository its folder is in, or the
repositories inside its folder.

post.summary: Marks conflicted files resolved (stages them).

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

post.summary: Stages files, or everything.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

post.summary: Sets a file's staged content: stages or unstages hunks and lines.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

get.summary: The stashes, newest first.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

post.summary: Stashes the changes.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

post.summary: Applies a stash; with `pop`, removes it once applied.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description: A repository inside the project's folder; absent for the one it is in.

get.summary: The project's Git status: branch, upstream, ahead and behind, and its changes by group (an empty answer with `repository: false` outside any repository).

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

post.summary: Switches branch (a remote one: a local branch tracking it), stashing changes first when asked.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

post.summary: Unstages files, or everything.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description:
A repository inside the project's folder (its path there); absent
for the repository the folder is in.

get.summary: A project image for the file viewer or a Markdown document.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Relative to the project, with `/`; empty for its root.

409.description: Unsupported image or larger than 10 MiB

get.summary: A project's saved windows; 404 `layout_not_found` before the first save.

put.summary: Saves a project's windows over the revision the client last read.

get.summary:
A project's problems, as last reported by its language servers,
linters and checks; grouped by file, filtered by severity, source,
path and text.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Only this file's, or those under this folder.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Only those whose message, code or path contains this.

get.summary: A project's problem totals.

A project's repositories and worktrees that were used (a file opened
in them, or changed by an agent) or pinned, and which are active.

put.summary:
Pins a repository (or one of its worktrees), which keeps it active, or
unpins it.

post.summary:
Searches the project's files' contents, following `.gitignore`, at most
2,000 matches and 10 seconds.

422.description: `validation_failed`: a pattern that does not parse

post.summary:
Searches the project's files' contents like `search`, but answers as
the machine finds them: newline-delimited JSON, a `SearchFrame` per line
(`files`, then one `done`). Closing the request stops the search.

422.description: `validation_failed`: a pattern that does not parse

post.summary:
Starts a terminal in a project: a terminal session, running the login
shell (or a command) in the project's folder.

403.description: `other_machine_not_allowed`: a machine's token, for a project on another machine

get.summary:
A project's tool choices: tools per language and their order, format
on save, check commands, the environment, languages turned off. They
follow the project to every machine.
One project, by name or ID.

delete.summary:
Deletes a project and everything Ahab keeps for it. Files are never
touched.

patch.summary:
Renames, describes, groups, archives or restores a project, or changes
its mode.

200.description: First-message commands for this project and agent

get.summary: A project's image mark.

put.summary: Gives a project its own mark: an emoji, or a small image.

delete.summary: Takes a project's own mark away: its initial shows again.

get.summary: A project's folders of sessions, by name.

post.summary: Creates a folder of sessions in a project.

get.summary:
Searches a project's sessions: their titles, and the messages you and
the agents wrote in them. Titles first, then messages, newest first.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The words to find; each must appear (any case).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many titles and this many messages (1 to 200; 50 by default).

get.summary: A project's sessions with their chats, most recent activity first.

post.summary:
Starts a session in a project: its conversation with an agent. Its
title is the given one, else the first message's.

get.summary: The browsers that get pushes, oldest first.

post.summary:
Subscribes this browser: it gets pushes while "outside the app" is on.
Subscribing again with the same endpoint replaces the old one.

422.description: `validation_failed`: not an https endpoint or not real keys

post.summary: Pushes a test notification to a browser.

get.summary: The server's VAPID public key, which browsers subscribe with.

delete.summary: Deletes a folder; what it held (sessions and folders) moves up to where it was.

patch.summary:
Renames a folder, moves it into another folder (or to the top level),
or pins it.

get.summary: How many sessions need you, per project.
One session with its chats.

delete.summary: Deletes an archived session with its chats and their history.

patch.summary: Renames, pins or files a session; absent fields stay as they are.

post.summary:
Archives a session: its live chats end, and it is listed apart. Its
history is kept.

get.summary: A session's chats, most recently changed first.

post.summary:
Starts another chat in a session, beside its other chats and terminals: the
same as a new session's first, filed here.

get.summary: The files a session's agents edited, from their recorded file changes.

200.description: The files, as the agents named them

post.summary:
Starts a terminal in a session, beside its chats and other terminals, in the
project's folder; `title` names it there.
Brings an archived session back to the list.

get.summary:
A section of settings: its fields, the values in effect (for the
project, when given) and the values set for the server and the project.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project's ID: its values, over the server's.

patch.summary:
Changes settings for the server, or for a project (`project`): each
named field takes its value; `null` unsets it there.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project's ID: its values, over the server's.

requestBody.description: Field names and their new values, or `null`

422.description: `validation_failed`: an unknown field or a value that does not fit

get.summary:
The terminals a plugin started, oldest first. A machine's token sees
only its own machine's.
A terminal's state.

403.description: `other_machine_not_allowed`: a machine's token, for another machine's terminal

delete.summary:
Removes a terminal from its session: an exited one, or a running one
with `stop=true`, which ends its process.

parameters.name: stop
parameters.description: Stop it first if it runs; else a running one is refused.

409.description: `terminal_running`: stop it first, or ask with `stop=true`

patch.summary: Renames a terminal, or moves it to another session of its project.

post.summary: Ends a terminal's process; the terminal stays, exited.

403.description: `other_machine_not_allowed`: a machine's token, for another machine's terminal

post.summary: Runs a terminal's shell (or command) again.

AddAgent.description:
Adds an agent to a machine: one from the registry by `agent`
(`acp:<id>`), or a custom one by `name` and `program`.

program.description: A custom agent's program (a path, or a name looked up on `PATH`).

AddedAgent.description: An agent added to a machine.

custom.description: A custom command, not a registry agent.

AgentCatalog.description: Every agent Ahab can run, and where the registry part came from.

registryVersion.description:
The ACP registry's version, and whether it is the copy shipped with
Ahab (`bundled`) or fetched (`fetched`).

AgentChoice.description: A choice an agent offers, picked with `select`.

AgentCommand.description: A session entry that the agent can invoke.

AgentDefaults.description:
What an agent starts with unless chosen otherwise: the last model,
reasoning effort and permission mode picked for it, on any device.

AgentFormField.description: One field of a form request: a flat JSON-schema property.

default.description: Any JSON value, as the field takes it.

minimum.description: Bounds of a number's value, a text's length, a multi-select's count.

AgentHistory.description: A subagent's conversation so far, as the events that show it.

efforts.description: Reasoning efforts, in the agent's order; empty when it has none.

oneOf.description: Its fast tier, where it offers one.

AgentModels.description: The models an agent offers on a machine.

fetchedAt.description: When the agent was asked for them.

refreshing.description: They are being read again in the background.

AgentQuestion.description: One question of a question request.

allowOther.description: Your own words are welcome (an answer's `other`).

secret.description: The answer is secret, such as a password.

label.description: An answer's `selected` names options by it.

preview.description: Markdown to show beside it, such as a mockup.

AgentRequest.description:
A request an agent waits on, as Stubb sends it (`request::Request`).
Clients show a `kind` they do not know as a plain permission.

oneOf.description: Permission to call a tool with `input`.
Permission to call a tool, with the agent's own choices (ACP).
Questions for you, each with options and often your own words.
The agent's plan, waiting for approval.

options.description: Ways to approve it, such as Claude Code's permission modes.

oneOf.description: A form to fill in (MCP or ACP elicitation), or a page to open (`url`).

AgentState.description: Whether an agent can be used on a machine.

AgentStatus.description: An agent's readiness on a machine.

account.description: The signed-in account, when the agent names it.

detail.description: Why something could not be determined.

label.description: A readable name, such as "Claude Code".

path.description: Where the agent's program is on the machine.

AgentStatusList.description: The agents on one machine, as last detected.

AgentUpdate.description:
Whether a newer version of an agent is out, and whether Ahab can install
it on the machine.

canUpdate.description: Ahab can update it here (with the agent's own updater).

command.description: The command that updates it: the one Ahab runs, or what to do instead.

latest.description:
The newest release on the channel it follows; absent when it could not
be looked up.

reason.description: Why Ahab cannot update it, or why the latest version is unknown.

AgentUpdateList.description: The agents on one machine that could be updated.

output.description: The end of what the updater printed.

success.description: The updater finished without an error.

AgentUsage.description: An agent's plan limits on one machine, for the account signed in there.

problem.description: Why there is nothing (or not everything) to show.

windows.description: The limits, most important first; empty unless `available`.

count.description: How many: agent sessions, terminals; one for a plugin or Ahab.

cpuPercent.description: Busy, as a share of the whole machine, 0 to 100.

AnswerRequest.description: An answer to a request: the decision, and what it needs.

message.description: With `deny`: why, for the agent; for a plan, what to change.

values.description: With `submit`: the values by field name; empty for a page opened.

AppMetrics.description: The processes of one program, together.

path.description: Where it is on the project's machine.

addable.description:

monochrome.description: The logo is drawn in one colour: show it in the text's colour.

version.description: The release the registry points at.

Chat.description: A conversation with a coding agent in a project.

messageSubmissions.description: This server supports durable submission IDs on messages.

mode.description:

`fullAccess`; none for Pi.

openRequests.description: Requests waiting for an answer, as the agent sent them.

resumable.description: Once ended, a message continues it (the agent's session is known).

unrestricted.description: The agent runs without asking for permission (Pi).

historyBefore.description: When reading backward, pass this as `before` for the next page, or 0 at the beginning.

more.description: More events follow in the requested direction.

ChatEventRecord.description: One kept event of a session: Stubb's event, numbered.

ChatModel.description:
A chat's model and effort, and the ones it goes on with at its next
message when another was chosen while it ran.

fast.description: Fast mode, if chosen; else the provider's default.

ChatStopReceipt.description: What the provider acknowledged when asked to stop the selected work.

ChatStopTarget.description: One task or delegated agent in a live chat.

ChatTurn.description:

ChatTurns.description: A chat's turns: each message the person sent, oldest first.

ChatUsage.description: What a chat's agent has spent so far, as it reported it after each turn.

costUsd.description:
What it cost in US dollars, as the agent reports it; none for agents
that report no cost.

tokens.description: Tokens its turns used, added up; none before the agent reports any.

CheckRootDto.description: A check's root, before it runs (`tools.checkRoots`).

checkout.description:
The repository or worktree it is in, relative to the project

root.description: The root, relative to the project (empty for its folder).

`tools.checkRoots`' answer, and `GET /projects/{id}/check-roots`:

askAbove.description: With more roots than this, Check project asks which to check.

checkout.description: The repository or worktree the root is in.

ChecksDto.description: What `POST /projects/{id}/checks` ran, and the problems after it.

Client.description: A client paired with this server.

Whether it was last used over HTTPS, this computer or a tailnet:

lastAddress.description: The address it was last used from.

lastUsedAt.description: Written at most once a minute.

pairedBy.description:
The client that let it in; absent for this computer and clients

unused.description: Not used for 90 days. It is never revoked for it.

CommandInvocation.description: The selected provider identity accompanies the user's visible invocation.

ContextReference.description: Context for the agent, sent with a message.

label.description:

language.description: The code block's language, when known.

path.description: The file, relative to the project (lines, files, diff hunks).

text.description: The text as it was seen; empty for a whole file.

version.description:
The file's version when it was selected (`FileContent.version`): a
file changed since is said to have changed.

CoreFeature.description: A core feature of Ahab (not a plugin).

CoreFeatureChange.description: Switching a feature on or off.

CpuMetrics.description: The processors: how busy they are, together and each.

load.description: The load average over 1, 5 and 15 minutes (not on Windows).

usagePercent.description: Busy, 0 to 100, over all logical cores.

content.description: A new file's content; empty when absent.

path.description: Relative to the project; missing parent folders are made too.

name.description: The name the machine gets; else its hostname.

firstRun.description:
The first-run link instead: for this computer only, while no other
client is paired. It works for 24 hours, has no code, and replaces
earlier first-run links.

CreatePairingRequest.description: A new client asks to be paired.

name.description: The name approvers see; browsers are named from their `User-Agent`.

CreateProject.description: A new project: a folder on a machine.

path.description: The folder's absolute path on that machine.

CreatePushSubscription.description:
A browser subscribing: what `PushSubscription.toJSON()` gives, and a
label for Settings.

CreateSession.description: A new session: its conversation with an agent.

folderId.description: The project's folder to file it in; else none.

serverFingerprint.description:
The server's key fingerprint, which the joining machine pins
(`ahab setup --server-fingerprint`). Absent from servers before it.

serverUrl.description:
The address machines join at: `public_url`, else the address this
request used (another machine's view of it when that was this
computer's own). Absent from servers before it.

CreatedJoinCode.description: A code that was just created, with the code itself.

CreatedPairing.description: A pairing link just created: its secret and code are shown only now.

code.description:
The code to type on the new client instead; none on a first-run
link.

secret.description: The secret alone, for clients that make their own link.

url.description: The link: whoever opens it is paired. The secret is after `#`.

CreatedPairingRequest.description: A request just made: show the code, and wait with the secret.

code.description: What this client shows, for the approver to compare.

CreatedToken.description: A token that was just created: shown only in this answer.

token.description: Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, or set `AHAB_TOKEN`.

Decision.description:
What an answer to a request does. A permission (`tool`, `permission`)
takes `allow`, `allowForSession`, `deny`, `cancel` or `select`; a
question `answer`; a plan `allow`, `select` or `deny` (keep planning, with
feedback); a form `submit` or `deny` (decline). Every kind takes `deny`
and `cancel`.

Delivery.description: How a message sent while the agent works reaches it.

machines.description: Where it runs, for a plugin whose placement is `chosen`.

code.description: A one-time code: the machine is approved at once.

publicKey.description: The machine's Ed25519 public key, in base64.

signature.description:
Its signature of `ahab/enroll/v1`, the host it asked and the key, in
base64.

Enrollment.description: A machine's request to join, and where it stands.

checkCode.description: The code to compare with the web app before approving.

id.description: The machine's ID; follow it with `GET /api/v1/enrollments/{id}`.

serverFingerprint.description: The server's key fingerprint, which the machine pins.

mise.description: Use mise or asdf's files (on by default).

nix.description:
Use the flake's dev shell (`nix develop`); off by default, as it can
take long to start.

FastMode.description: A model's faster tier (Claude Code's and Codex's fast mode).

defaultOn.description: Whether the provider turns it on by default for the model.

FieldError.description:
One invalid field, for `validation_failed`. Nested fields use dots, such as
`folder.path`.

binary.description: Not text: no content is sent.

truncated.description:
Only the file's first part was sent (`partial`); it cannot be
edited.

version.description:
The file's version: a hash of its content. A save names the version
it started from. Absent from older machines, and for a
file sent only in part.

FileEntry.description: One entry of a folder inside a project.

FileIndex.description: A project's files, for quick open.

paths.description: Relative to the project, following its ignore rules.

FileListing.description: A folder inside a project: folders first, then files, by name.

path.description: Relative to the project; empty for its root.

truncated.description: More entries exist than were listed.

hidden.description: Its name starts with a dot.

FolderListing.description: A folder on a machine, for picking a project's folder.

parent.description: Its parent, or none at the root.

truncated.description: More subfolders exist than were listed.

ForkChat.description: Fork at this stored turnEnd event, into the same or a fresh session.

commit.description: Its last commit, short, with its summary and time.

added.description: Lines added and removed; absent for binary files.

refs.description:
The refs pointing at it: `HEAD`, `main`, `origin/main`, `tag: v1`.
`HEAD -> main` is given as `HEAD` then `main`.

GitCommitDetail.description: A commit with its message and files.

from.description: A branch or commit to start from; else the current one.

force.description: Also when it is not merged.

binary.description: Not text: no sides are sent.

index.description:
The file's index entry (a blob ID), for staging part of it; absent
when it is not in the index. Sent only for changes, staged and
untracked files whose sides are exact text (UTF-8), the only ones
whose parts can be staged.

old.description: Absent when the file did not exist on that side.

partial.description: Whether parts of it can be staged or unstaged (see `index`).

tooLarge.description: Larger than 2 MiB: no sides are sent.

GitOutput.description: What Git said, after an operation that changed something.

inside.description:
The project's folder is in a repository (then `repositories` is
empty: that one is used).

repositories.description: Repositories found inside the folder, otherwise.

GitRepository.description: A repository inside the project's folder.

oneOf.description:
A repository's own checkout or a worktree. Absent from
older daemons.

path.description: Its folder, relative to the project's.

repository.description:
The repository it checks out, the same for all its worktrees: that
repository's folder relative to the project's (absolute when
outside it). Absent from older daemons.

content.description: The file's whole staged content after the change.

index.description:
The index entry the content was made from (`GitDiff.index`); the
change is refused if it has moved on since.

GitStatus.description: Where the project stands in Git.

branch.description: The current branch; absent when `HEAD` is detached.

head.description: The commit `HEAD` is at, short; absent before the first commit.

prefix.description:
The project's folder within the repository (`""` when it is the
repository; `"packages/web/"` in a larger one).

repository.description: False when the project's folder is in no repository.

remote.description: `branch` is a remote branch: switch to a local one tracking it.

HealthStatus.description: Always `ok`: an answer means the server is up.

location.description: A folder on the server's host, or a Git URL.

InstalledPlugin.description: A plugin as installed, and what its manifest should fix.

JoinCode.description:
A one-time code that still works. The code itself is shown only once,
when it is created.

formatter.description: The tool that formats, when not the first that can.

tools.description: Its tools, in order of preference, instead of the defaults.

detail.description: Why it failed, or what it is busy with.

documents.description: How many files are open in it.

languages.description: The languages of the files open in it.

memory.description: Its memory, in bytes, when the machine says.

root.description: Its root, as an absolute path on the machine.

memory.description: What they take together, in bytes. Absent from older daemons.

memoryBudget.description: What they may take together (the machine's memory budget), in bytes.

Machine.description: A computer that runs a daemon.

checkCode.description: A short code to compare with the joining machine's screen.

fingerprint.description: The key's fingerprint, to compare when approving a machine.

missingMethods.description:
The methods its connected daemon lacks; empty while it is
not connected.

online.description: Whether its daemon is connected right now.

outdated.description:
Its connected daemon runs an older Ahab, without some of the methods
this server calls: what needs them fails with `machine_outdated`
until it is updated. False while it is not connected.

ahab.description: What Ahab uses the machine for, busiest first.

apps.description: Processes grouped by program, the busiest and largest.

history.description: Samples of the last 10 minutes, every 3 seconds, oldest first.

osVersion.description: The operating system in full, such as "Linux 26.05 NixOS".

The busiest processes (by CPU and by memory), every one Ahab
started, and the busiest of each app below.

MetricsSample.description: The machine at one moment of the last minutes, for its charts.

ahabCpu.description: Busy for Ahab and everything it started, 0 to 100.

load.description: The load average over one minute (0 on Windows).

ModelEffort.description: A reasoning effort a model accepts.

Moving or copying a file or folder inside the project (dragging it in

parentId.description: The folder to make it in; else the project's top level.

Notification.description: Something that happened, for the inbox.

Unread ones of a group stand for it: a newer one replaces the older

target.description:
What opening it shows: `{"type": "session", "projectId",
"sessionId", "chatId"}`; other types may come.

The agents working now: a phone's background connection stays while
there are some.

NotificationCount.description: How many notifications a change touched.

NotificationKind.description: A kind of notification, and whether it is on.

outside.description:
Shown outside the app too (the system's notifications, phones), while
notifications go outside at all.

sourceName.description: What Settings groups it under: Ahab, or the plugin's name.

keepDays.description: Days read notifications are kept; none keeps them forever.

outside.description: Shown outside the app too: the browser's, the desktop's, the phone's.

NotificationSettingsChange.description: Changing the settings: all of them at once.

insideOnly.description: Kinds shown only inside Ahab, never outside it.

kinds.description: Kinds by ID, on or off; kinds left out are on.

OpenFolder.description: A folder to open: its project, or a new project for it.

machine.description: The machine's name or ID; or else `machineFingerprint`.

project.description: When the folder is several projects: which one.

Pair.description: Pairs this client: with a link's secret or a code, one of them.

kind.description:

others get the credential in the answer.

Its credential, for `Authorization: Bearer`; shown only now. Absent
for browsers, which get it as a cookie they cannot read.

credential.description:
The credential, once approved; shown only in this answer. Absent
for browsers, which get it as a cookie.

PairingLink.description: A pairing link, to see whether it was used.

PairingRequest.description: A request waiting for an answer, as approvers see it.

worktree.description:
A worktree of it; the repository as a whole (all its worktrees) when
absent.

dependsOn.description: Other plugins it uses, with version ranges.

digest.description: Which build is installed (SHA-256 of its files).

machines.description: Where it runs, for a plugin whose placement is `chosen`.

declared.description:
What it declared when it started (commands, channels, hooks,

message.description: Why, when it is restarting, failed or unavailable.

since.description: Since when it is in this state.

groupKey.description: Unread ones of the same group are replaced.

kind.description: A kind the plugin's manifest declares, without its ID.

id.description:

off, notifications off, or a hook dropped it).

values.description: The values set at this scope.

fixes.description:

counts.description: Of every problem, before the filters.

readPerSecond.description: Read from and written to disk, per second, lately.

script.description: The script, for interpreters such as `node` (`codex.js`).

RenameFile.description: Moving a file or folder inside the project.

active.description: Pinned, or used within the project's active days.

repository.description:
The repository's folder, relative to the project (`""` for the
project's own).

worktree.description: The worktree's folder, when it is one.

activeDays.description: How many days a repository stays active after it was used.

checkouts.description:
Only in these repositories or worktrees (folders relative to the
project, `""` for files in none); everywhere when absent.

tools.description:
Only these checks, by tool ID; every check that runs on request when

version.description: Its new version, for the next save.

A streamed search's line: files with matches as they are found, then
how it ended. Sent to the browser as newline-delimited JSON.

includeIgnored.description: Also files that `.gitignore` excludes, and hidden ones.

Why results stopped early: `matches` (the limit was reached) or

attachments.description: Attachments uploaded to the project, sent with the message.

Context for the agent, sent after the message as text it can read: each

text.description: May be empty when files are attached or context is added.

paths.description: Paths as the agents gave them, usually absolute; sorted.

command.description: A command for the login shell to run; the shell itself otherwise.

settings.description:

output.description: The output so far, last lines.
